description.value: Money orchestration for B2B platforms: lets a platform's users and agents issue and use cards, pay bills and manage cash, while CapitalOS handles risk, underwriting, compliance and capital.
Money orchestration for B2B platforms: lets a platform's users and agents issue and use cards, pay bills and manage cash, while CapitalOS handles risk, underwriting, compliance and capital.
An embedded spend-management company for B2B platforms that offers business credit cards, expense management and bill pay to their users.

product_description.value: Business credit cards, pre-funded balance cards, expense management, a business wallet that holds and grows customers' cash, AI-assisted bill pay (AP) and automated payment collection (AR).
Business credit cards, balance cards, expense management, a business wallet, bill pay (AP) and payment collection (AR).
Business credit cards, expense management and bill pay, offered to platform users.
